provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Stone Age rules (Hans im Gluck / Z-Man, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Food tokens sorted on the hunting grounds
28 wood on the forest, 18 clay on the clay mound, 12 stone on the quarry, 10 gold on the river
Tool tiles sorted (1/2 and 3/4) on the village
Civilization cards shuffled; reveal 4 onto their spaces, starting from the rightmost
Building tiles shuffled into piles of 7: {n} piles on the board, top tile of each revealed; box the rest unseen
Small marker on 0 of the agriculture track, big marker on 0 of the scoring track
Player board with 5 figures and Food worth {n}
The other 5 figures per color, the 7 dice and the dice cup by the board
The youngest player takes the First player token and places figures first
